---
title: XR Modes
---

Select to fade between passthrough and a colored virtual background. The
application's objects remain in the scene while the background changes.

`XRTransition` changes visual presentation inside the current session. It does
not replace an immersive-AR session with an immersive-VR session. Use startup
configuration when the application needs a different session type.

[Rendering and background transitions](/sdk/rendering) · [Startup](/sdk/configuration) · [Example catalog](/examples)
